label: A3B3C2_hR8_166_d_ac_c-001
title: K$_{3}$Cu$_{3}$P$_{2}$
comments:
The \href{../../Tutorial/AFLOW_Prototype_Label/index.html#LabelOrder}{AFLOW prototype label protocol} moves the K I atom from the (1b) site, as given in (Savelsberg, 1978) to the (1a) site, shifting all atomic coordinates by ( 0 , 0 , 1/2 c). 
 This structure is given in the rhombohedral setting of space group $R\overline{3}m$ \#166. The hexagonal setting may be obtained by adding {\tt --hex} to the aflow command.
